title: Commercial Expansion Intern
description: About PERGOLUX PERGOLUX is building a category-defining outdoor-living brand—online and now in physical retail. We move fast, test ideas in the real world and give ambitious people room to shape what comes next. The Opportunity PERGOLUX is at the starting line of a major new phase of commercial expansion: building a Germany-wide showroom network and the model that can scale beyond it. This is a chance to join while the playbook is still blank. Working close to leadership, you will help answer where we expand, how we evaluate opportunities, which economics matter and what systems will make the model repeatable. This is not a pure strategy role. You will call people, chase answers, test live opportunities and build working tools. But your real output is the blueprint—not simply executing a rollout manual, but helping write it. What You’ll Build Find the expansion logic Map priority markets, customer demand, retail formats and competitive dynamics. Speak with brokers, landlords, operators and internal teams to test assumptions and close information gaps. Use live location opportunities to learn which criteria truly predict a great showroom. Build the commercial model Create business cases and scenarios around rent, investment, revenue potential and payback. Define practical scorecards, decision gates and evidence standards for location choices. Turn incomplete data into clear recommendations and commercial trade-offs. Design the expansion operating system Shape the pipeline, workflows, handovers and information structure behind future expansion. Build lightweight dashboards, automations, templates and AI-enabled tools that remove repetitive work. Identify what should be standardised across markets—and what should stay flexible. Write the playbook from the first showrooms Compare early assumptions with actual results and customer feedback. Capture what worked, what failed and what should change before the next wave. Turn those lessons into a scalable roadmap and clear guidance for future execution teams. Your Business Impact Give PERGOLUX a clear answer to where, when and under what conditions physical retail should scale. Make location decisions faster, more consistent and grounded in economics rather than intuition. Create a repeatable expansion playbook that lowers risk and management effort for every new showroom. What You’ll Bring You are enrolled in or recently graduated from university; your field matters less than how you think and execute. You are a sharp, curious generalist who enjoys moving between research, conversations, numbers and building. You get energy from messy problems, create structure quickly and do not wait for a perfect brief. You are willing to get your hands dirty—whether that means making calls, cleaning data or testing a rough solution. You can turn imperfect information into a clear point of view and communicate it confidently in German and English. You are happy to travel across Germany when real-world learning beats another desk-based analysis. Nice to Have Exposure to commercial real estate, retail, consulting, startups, operations or business development—helpful, not required. Experience building a business case, process, dashboard, automation or internal tool from scratch. A strong instinct for what is commercially useful, not just analytically interesting. AI-Native Is a Plus Bonus points if you use AI tools to turn repetitive work into lightweight solutions—not just to draft messages. Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Replit or similar AI coding tools. Vibe-coding or rapid-prototyping experience: automations, scrapers, dashboards, small internal tools or data workflows. You do not need a computer-science degree; curiosity, judgment and the ability to ship something useful matter more. What We Offer A rare chance to help design a new growth engine at an early stage. Build the commercial model

Design the expansion operating system

  • Build lightweight dashboards, automations, templates and AI-enabled tools that remove repetitive work.

Your Business Impact

description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave’s Physical AI team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, robotics, advanced manufacturing systems, and batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of the core components of our Physical AI platform. We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship capabilities spanning agentic experiences, applied AI workflows, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering and industrial workflows, identify where emerging AI technologies can create meaningful value, turn field signals into scalable platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth, product judgement, and customer empathy.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run discovery in the field, and spend time in front of customers</li> <li>Decide what we build. You’ll take a candidate product from problem to validated concept; use case, customer proof points, and the business case for continuing or stopping</li> <li>Ship products in a small squad, setting roadmap and sequencing work required.</li> <li>Keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned. For the products you own: a one-line pitch, short summary and demo that anyone in the company can follow - what it is, why we’re building it, what’s next.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience across product management, product strategy, technical programme leadership, or related roles, with a strong track record of turning complex technologies into products, platforms, or customer outcomes.</li> <li>High versatility with a proven ability to work across multiple technical domains, such as ML modelling, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, advanced manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency with the ability to confidently discuss APIs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, AI systems, and platform trade-offs with engineers, researchers, and technical customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated cross-functional leadership, skilled at aligning diverse teams across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, and commercial functions while managing technical dependencies and balancing constraints with business objectives.</li> <li>Deep customer empathy with a curiosity for understanding complex engineering and industrial workflows, diagnosing friction points, and identifying where new technologies can fundamentally improve how customers work.</li> <li>Absolute execution focus with a proven ability to build clarity out of ambiguity, move comfortably between strategy and hands-on delivery, maintain high attention to detail, and drive initiatives from concept through execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in engineering, physical research, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or applied data science, prototyping tools; our PMs are builders first and regularly use technology to explore ideas, validate concepts, and accelerate product development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li><strong>You love to</strong> build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept to launch.</li> <li><strong>You're curious about</strong> emerging Physical AI technologies, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, and how they can be applied to transform real-world industrial and engineering challenges.</li> <li><strong>You're an expert in</strong> cross-functional execution, seamlessly connecting the dots between deeply technical engineering and research teams, enterprise customers, and commercial priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

raw.title: Finance & Reconciliation Analyst / Safeguarding
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst to join our Safeguarding function at Pleo.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of how we meet our safeguarding obligations under FCA rules. You'll perform daily and periodic reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions, contribute to process improvement initiatives, and support our external audit activity. You'll also help produce the management information that feeds into our governance oversight. If you're genuinely curious about payments and financial infrastructure, good with data, and keen to learn and improve as you go, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Head of Safeguarding and work closely with teams across Finance Operations, Compliance, and Product.

Our Finance function is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding and financial control. You'll also have the opportunity to partner with colleagues across our operations, audit, and leadership teams to help drive strong governance and regulatory compliance.

What you'll be doing

As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:

  • Perform and support the review of daily and periodic safeguarding reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions

  • Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity

  • Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution

  • Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails

  • Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee

  • Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly

  • Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team

  • Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign

  • Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them

  • Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time

  • Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit

  • Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role

  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further

  • A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors

  • Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice

  • A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways

  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

  • You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

  • You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

  • You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

  • You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams

  • You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations

  • Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes

  • Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation

  • Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our Head of Safeguarding & Reconciliation

  • Pleo challenge: A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges

  • Final Interview: A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Supply Planner
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>Anduril is seeking a Senior Supply Planner to join our team in Sydney, Australia. The Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and sourcing of materials to support rapidly iterating and building of cutting-edge defense hardware for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV). You will have responsibility spanning the entire value chain from raw materials through finished goods and contributing to the strategic supply network development of Anduril’s product hardware, across their life cycles. You will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO:</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with design and manufacturing engineers to accelerate product development via activities such as:</li> <ul> <li>build bottom-up cost models, using supplier data and manufacturing insight to benchmark pricing and identify cost drivers</li> <li>rapidly align on build requirements, constraints, and feasibility against schedule</li> <li>Perform impact assessment on build schedule when change reviews are proposed and implemented</li> </ul> <li>Own and maintain the line of balance (LOB) for assigned programs, ensuring material availability is synchronised to the master build schedule. You'll be the connective tissue between procurement, production, and engineering — translating build requirements into actionable supply plans and driving resolution when gaps threaten schedule</li> <li>Drive and support clear-to-build (CTB) reviews ahead of each build phase, confirming all materials, long-lead items, and supplier deliverables are on hand or on track</li> <li>Collaborate with procurement to expedite, re-sequence, or source alternatives when supply risks emerge, escalating early with data-backed recommendations</li> <li>Track and report schedule adherence metrics (OTD, CTB pass rate, LOB health) and drive root cause analysis on misses.</li> <li>Maintain MRP/ERP system accuracy — planned orders, lead times, safety stock parameters, and demand signals aligned to current program baselines.</li> <li>Support all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle</li> <li>Support new product introduction (NPI) builds by developing initial supply plans from early-stage BOMs and engineering change orders.</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:</h3> <ul> <li>Ideally has background within:</li> <ul> <li>7+ years in supply planning, production planning, or materials management within a complex hardware manufacturing environment, preferably defence or aerospace.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing line of balance and clear-to-build processes across multi-level BOMs with long-lead and constrained materials.</li> <li>Track record of maintaining build schedule adherence in a rate production or NPI environment.Design &amp; development of electronics and/or mechanical devices</li> <li>Advanced supply planning experience, including stints in production planning, materials management, or master scheduling roles</li> </ul> <li>Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment</li> <li>Prior knowledge of Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CPIM, CSCP, or CPSM, or an advanced degree, are strongly preferred</li> <li>Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2)</li> </ul> <h3>Soft Skills and Leadership:</h3> <ul> <li>Strong communication skills — ability to present material risk and recovery plans to program managers and senior leadership with clarity and confidence.</li> <li>Comfort operating in ambiguity, particularly during early-stage programs where BOMs are evolving and requirements are fluid.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with a bias for action — someone who chases answers rather than waiting for them.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335551550&quot;:0,&quot;335551620&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group&nbsp;Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&amp;C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> communications capabilities.&nbsp;</span><span description: Who are we? Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business. The Team Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely. About the Role: This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need. What you will do: Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams. Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products. Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping. Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations. Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis. Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient. Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits. Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences. Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper. Role Requirements: Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure. Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements. AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices. CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair). Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC. Compliance as Code: Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and compliance-as-code practices. Automation Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one of Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of automating security processes. Nice-to-have: Demonstrated experience deploying AI security solutions, guardrails, and defences for AI systems used by customers; a personal interest in sports, exchanges, or trading; certifications such as DSOP, CKS, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, or an AWS/Azure/GCP Security Specialty; a track record of security automation at scale in Agile/Scrum environments; direct experience with regulators/examiners on technology and system safeguards; and familiarity with event contracts, prediction markets, or similar novel futures products under CFTC. Our Values Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard. Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us. Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment. Perks & Benefits We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win. Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth, and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally. These include: Stock Options: Vest over 4 years, your success is our success. Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in. Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life's most important moments. Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food. Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active. Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training. Holiday: 25 days paid leave plus bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days. Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.   • Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products.

Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product, trading, data, and commercial teams to align marketing with the wider business roadmap. D2C Experience: Real experience growing a D2C/consumer business where you owned the relationship with the customer directly. Multiple markets: Has successfully executed a marketing strategy for multiple geographic or cultural regions. Efficient Growth: A demonstrable record of growing a business through efficient acquisition; we want to see strong ROI, not just big spend. Full-Funnel Fluency: You've owned brand, performance acquisition, and retention, and understand how they compound. raw.description:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world's most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We're a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting, from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

If you're ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

We welcome applications from candidates who are genuinely energised by the challenge of building a brand and a growth engine at scale, and who have the track record to prove it. We look forward to reviewing your application.

The Team

This role sits at the heart of our commercial strategy, overseeing marketing teams and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, trading, data, and the executive team to grow the business. Prediction markets and exchange products are having a moment, and the team's job is to capture that energy: building the Smarkets brand and the brands within our group, and making every pound of the marketing budget work harder than the last.

About the Role:

As our VP Commercial & Marketing, you'll be responsible for every marketing lever we have: brand, acquisition, and retention, across multiple markets, including UK and US. Your team will be accountable for how the world discovers Smarkets and the brands within our group, why they choose us over anyone else, and why they stay.

We're looking for a senior leader who has scaled a direct-to-consumer brand before and understands the pitfalls and opportunities. We need someone who will set the strategy for marketing and roll up their sleeves to execute. If you want to direct from a distance, this isn't the role for you. If you want to own the number, build up the team, and be measured on the growth you deliver, read on.

You will own the marketing budget, and we'll expect you to make every pound work harder than the last. Success looks like ROI and disciplined scaling; failure looks like vanity spend that fails to deliver the unit economics. This role reports to the COO and sits at the heart of our commercial strategy.

What you will do:

  • Own the Strategy: Own a multi-jurisdiction marketing strategy end-to-end, accountable for design and execution across brand, acquisition, and retention.

  • Shape Go-to-Market: Help develop the commercial strategy for go-to-market projects and our core brands.

  • Deliver ROI: Accountable for effective ROI on the annual marketing budget.

  • Build the Team: Mentor and develop a high-performing marketing team, raising the bar on talent and standards.

  • Scale Performance Marketing: Build the processes to scale performance marketing across paid channels, relentlessly improving CAC, ROAS, and payback.

  • Sharpen the Brand: Sharpen and grow the Smarkets brand: our positioning, our voice, and how we show up in a crowded market.

  • Drive Retention: Develop the retention and lifecycle strategy, turning first-time users into loyal, high-value traders through CRM and lifecycle marketing.

  • Own the Metrics: Define the metrics that matter, hold the team to them, and make decisions grounded in data.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product, trading, data, and commercial teams to align marketing with the wider business roadmap.

Role Requirements:

  • Proven Brand Builder: A senior marketing leader with a proven track record of scaling a brand.

  • D2C Experience: Real experience growing a D2C/consumer business where you owned the relationship with the customer directly.

  • Multiple markets: Has successfully executed a marketing strategy for multiple geographic or cultural regions.

  • Efficient Growth: A demonstrable record of growing a business through efficient acquisition; we want to see strong ROI, not just big spend.

  • Full-Funnel Fluency: You've owned brand, performance acquisition, and retention, and understand how they compound.

  • Genuinely Data-Driven: You live in the metrics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, payback) and use them to make hard calls.

  • Builder and Operator: Hands-on, decisive, and energised by getting things done rather than delegating them away.

  • Communicator: Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a fast-moving, cross-functional business.

  • Nice-to-have: Experience in sports, sports betting, or gaming is a strong plus.

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth, and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally. These include:

  • Stock Options: Vest over 4 years, your success is our success.

  • Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life's most important moments.

  • Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

  • Holiday: 25 days paid leave plus bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

title: Software Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Software Architect</strong></p> <p>At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p> <p><strong>Why this role matters now</strong></p> <p>This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.</p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:</p> <ul> <li>Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.</li> <li>Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.</li> <li>Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.</li> <li>Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.</li> <li>Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.</li> <li>Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.</li> <li>Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.</li> <li>Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.</li> <li>Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> <li>Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> <li>Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.</li> <li>Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.</li> <li>Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.</li> <li>Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security best practice (OWASP top ten)</li> <li>Azure SQL Server</li> <li>DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub</li> <li>Windows services</li> <li>Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do not require</strong></p> <p>We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.</p> <p><strong>About the interview process</strong></p> <p>The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>11267<br><strong>Reporting into:&nbsp;</strong>Manager<br><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-teams="true">#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior GTM System Builder
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>The commercial team at Mews moves deals through a complex, multi-touch GTM motion. The person in this role owns the systems that make that motion faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort — from inbound routing and deal enrichment to Gong-driven coaching intelligence and CPQ automation. This is not a support role for the commercial team. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.</p> <p>You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. You will work under staff technical direction but make your own architecture and build-vs-buy decisions within your domain. You will manage vendor relationships, define observability standards, and be the person who picks up the phone when something breaks in production.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would do</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Own the full lifecycle of automation and AI-tooling initiatives within your assigned GTM pod: scoping, building, shipping to production, and iterating based on adoption and KPI data — not just ticket completion</li> <li>Build and ship AI-powered pipelines that permanently remove manual GTM work: deal enrichment, outbound research and routing, Gong-driven coaching signals, forecasting inputs, CPQ automation, and proposal follow-up</li> <li>Design the prompting architecture and agent logic that commercial reps, BDRs, and AEs interact with daily — reliable outputs for non-technical end users, with observability and error handling built in from the start</li> <li>Own operational health of your domain's live systems: first responder when things break, with adoption metrics, error rates, and data quality visibility instrumented before deployment</li> <li>Manage vendor relationships at pod level (Gong, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, depending on assignment): SLAs, incident escalation, business reviews, and periodic build-vs-buy re-decisions</li> <li>Support other engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching on architecture trade-offs — and contribute reusable patterns and integrations that accelerate delivery across pod</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> In this role, AI is not a productivity layer — it is the product. You will architect and ship LLM-powered agents, enrichment pipelines, and AI-assisted automations that the commercial org depends on. You will make engineering decisions about models, infrastructure, and MCP integrations. You will design prompting systems that non-technical users rely on without ever touching a prompt themselves. The test for everything you build is whether a KPI moved — which means your judgment about where AI is trustworthy and where it needs a human in the loop is part of the work, not an afterthought.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>What you would bring</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>4 to 6 years delivering production software with measurable commercial impact in a product-driven company (high-growth SaaS, startup, or scale-up)</li> <li>Demonstrated end-to-end ownership with strong autonomy: you have defined the approach, navigated genuine ambiguity, and owned the outcome — not executed tickets</li> <li>Has shipped AI-powered pipelines or agents in a real operational context: enrichment, routing, summarization, or AI-assisted automation — not just prototypes</li> <li>Active practitioner of modern AI development tooling (Claude, Lovable, Cursor, or equivalent) and comfortable working with LLM APIs and MCP integrations — AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on engineering experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience building against Salesforce or equivalent CRM APIs: workflows, event-driven logic, and data integrations across multiple systems</li> <li>Comfortable owning live production systems: incident response, observability, vendor management, and data integrity — draws no hard line between building and running</li> <li>Can translate operational pain into technical requirements and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li>Experience in or alongside a RevOps or GTM function — understands what commercial reps actually need, not the idealized version</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Gong API, Clay, LeanData, or ZoomInfo integrations</li> <li>Familiarity with Nue/CPQ, Databricks, HubSpot, Hook, or Ada</li> </ul><div We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
